profile:
COMPANY NAME: SentinelOne
INDUSTRY: Cybersecurity / Enterprise Security
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: An AI-native cybersecurity platform providing unified protection across endpoint, identity, AI, and cloud environments. It features autonomous security intelligence to detect, contain, and respond to threats at machine speed.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Enterprise organizations, security operations centers (SOCs), and defenders managing complex IT environments including SaaS, on-premises, hybrid, and air-gapped systems.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Unified endpoint and identity security in a single lightweight agent
- Autonomous SOC capabilities with AI-automated response and remediation
- Real-time detection and disruption of identity-based attacks and ransomware
- Cloud security and protection for AI systems
- Support for diverse deployment models (SaaS, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- AI-native architecture designed to operate at machine speed to counter AI-driven threats
- "Human Amplification" approach where AI handles triage and routine tasks, allowing analysts to focus on high-value decisions
- Recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Endpoint Protection Platforms for six consecutive years
- Unified console for visibility, investigation, and action to reduce operational friction
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium / Developer-focused
